items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Louis Armstrong, by that time Louis left the band and went to New York to join Fletcher Henderson I think. And then Louis goes and joins Fletcher Henderson.

ctx.x: Yeah, Kelly Stables. And Joe Oliver, he went in with Dave Payton at the plantation. So I visited first one place or another, and Louis Armstrong, by that time Louis left the band and went to New York to join Fletcher Henderson I think. And then Louis goes and joins Fletcher Henderson. And then Ori comes up to join Joe Oliver and he had Bob Schaffner and Tick Gray on trumpets. And he had the same Charlie Jackson on bass, bass horn, and he had Albert Nichols and Bonnie Bigard on the- and Darnell Howard. Well…

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And that's where we had the great battle with the Castle Loma and Fletcher Henderson and Louis Armstrong Band.

ctx.x: You weren't a bad boy or anything? Oh no, no.

I'd never been to drugs, that's good. I'd never been to trouble. The only time I would have been in trouble, if you may recall, they put us all in jail in Memphis, the whole band. See we played, we did six weeks and when we left, see it was supposed to be a big dance here at the end of this game out there. And it's supposed to have some government warehouse or something like that. Anyhow, people came far away from Florida and Mississippi, you know, and Ramport Street and the people just, these little flippers,…
